notes: §1985:X.2.3.1 prints a source program as identification-division, then optional environment, data and procedure divisions in that order, then '[ procedure-division ] [ source-program ] …' and an optional end-program-header, the contained programs a bracket of their own after the procedure-division slot. The grammar's programUnit/nestedProgram fix the order and the trailing end marker; SourceUnitShape.Screen applies the 2002+ 'contained programs only after a procedure division' refusal only when ContainedFollowProcedureDivision (edition year >= 2002) holds, so at 85 a program without a Procedure Division may contain programs, and VersionConformancePass.VisitIdentificationDivision refuses the header-less 2002 form (COBOL0900). Probes at --std 85: (b) DATA before ENVIRONMENT, ENVIRONMENT twice, and a contained program placed before the container's PROCEDURE DIVISION each COBOL0001; END FUNCTION closing a program COBOL2274; (c) no IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header COBOL0900; nested-in-nested and sibling contained programs ran OUTER/D1/D11/D2; an inner program with only a DATA DIVISION containing another compiled clean at 85 and was refused at 2002 (COBOL2274); a lone identification division compiled. The witness runs OUTER containing INNER.

next.reason: 1985: "[ procedure-division ] [ source-program ] …"; 2023: "[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ] PROGRAM-ID. ... [ procedure-division [ program-definition ] … ]". 2023 allows nested programs only inside a present procedure division, which 1985 did not require. It also makes the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header optional and adds options-paragraph.
